frozen.variants_context: near541 x each alpha; nozero x each alpha; nozero with ex = beta - 2; x_ref + (+-0.01, +-0.01i, +-0.1, +-0.1i); the far end at the ratio-law kappa alone and with each alpha, near541, nozero, zpade; zfitratio; p0fit (P0 located by l2 at M = 20); afit (alpha located by l2 at M = 20); same rules, reported, not judged
frozen.errors_sizes_C1: #672's: measured rel_k (floor 1e-30), F = 1; M_min (least squares, chi <= 1), M_lo (l2 <= sqrt(n)), n = 23, M = 6..23; 150 digits checked at 250; C1 amended at M = n, on every scan; if C1 fires on real data the work stops. Context: errors widened to the strings' rounding (#683), J1500 at wf 1.00
frozen.locator: the zero (or P0) minimising log l2 at M = 20 = n - 3 (never chi at n - 1, #684): Nelder-Mead in offsets x = centre + scale (p + iq), scale 0.01, then rounds re-centred at the best point with scale / 100 until a round gains < 1e-3 in log l2 or scale < 1e-20; from each start (zero: x_ref and the Pade zero; P0: P0 and #541's near end), the lower l2 kept. afit: alpha on -0.9..2.0 step 0.1 by l2 at M = 20, then golden section to 1e-6
frozen.K0_ends: the near end of #541 reproduced: |near_inf - NEAR541| <= 1e-9 at every node; the far ends as #684's K0 (the ratio law within 1e-4 of #541, the poles past kappa_* within 1e-9)
frozen.K2_control: the issue's same-class control, at every node: the chord2 plant with alpha = 0.5 (P0, kappa_*, x_ref) (a) refitted in its own basis at its own M: chi <= 1e-30; (b) in the kstar basis (alpha = 0): M_min >= 19
frozen.C0_variants: every non-located variant basis, judged and context, at every node: the chord2 plant of the same spec, refitted in the variant's basis at its own M: chi <= 1e-30. A located variant: the same at its located value, in the real stage; a failure there is reported and that variant is not judged
frozen.Z1_locator: a chord2 plant with its zero at x_ref + 0.003 + 0.002i, at every node: (a) own basis chi <= 1e-30; (b) the zero locator, started as for zfit, returns the plant's zero within 1e-4. Z1 does not gate the real stage. If it fails, zfit and zfitratio are reported as uncalibrated, not judged
frozen.gate: the real stage runs only if K0, K2 and every C0 pass
frozen.C2_baseline: kstar reproduces #672's chord twin: M_min = 23 and chi at 22 terms within 1e-3 relative of REF672 at every node; a failure is a discrepancy, reported
frozen.mutation_control: --mutate=alpha adds 0.01 to every basis' alpha: K2(a), Z1(a) and every C0 must fail. --mutate=zero moves the zero of every basis that has one by +0.01: K2(a), Z1(a) and every C0 with a zero factor must fail, every C0 without one must pass. --mutate=locate makes the locator return its first start (x_ref) unsearched: Z1(b) must fail at every node (C0 is skipped). The scans and Z1(b) are skipped under alpha and zero. Each run exits 1
frozen.mutation_real: --mutate=c1dup (#672): column n - 1 of the 250-digit bases replaced by column n - 2, on the non-located variants; the amended C1 must fire on every scan with M_min = n and pass on every scan with M_min < n; exit 1
frozen.fits: a variant fits if M_min <= 20 at all three nodes (chord class)
frozen.verdict: names the fitting judged variants by ingredient: near-end exponent (a*), near-end position (near541), zero factor (nozero, zpade, zfit if Z1 passed); if none fits: none of the tested near ends or zero factors gives a short twin
frozen.context: chi at M = 20..22 and l2 at M = 20 per scan; the sensitivity (each judged variant's chord2 plant in the kstar basis; the kstar plant in the nozero and a+0.5 bases; K2's plant in the a+0.25 and a+1 bases; Z1's plant in the kstar basis); the Pade zero's error on the K2 and Z1 plants and its spread over [10/12], [12/10], [10/10], [11/10], [10/11] on the real series; widened errors (a changed judged verdict is a discrepancy, reported); J1500 at wf 1.00 for the judged variants
